Implemented binary serialization (`Encode` and `Decode`) for [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/shapeindex.go#L586-L635) on branch `shapeindex-encode`.

### Summary of Changes
- **[`ShapeIndex.Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/shapeindex.go#L1725-L1730) & [`ShapeIndex.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/shapeindex.go#L1809-L1813)**:
  - Triggers any pending updates before encoding so unbuilt indexes serialize their complete spatial cell structure.
  - Serializes index metadata (`maxEdgesPerCell`, `nextID`), shape ID mappings, all built-in `Shape` types ([`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/polygon.go#L52), [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/polyline.go#L43), [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/point_vector.go#L34), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/lax_polyline.go#L32), [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/lax_polygon.go#L70), [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/loop.go#L45), [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/lax_loop.go#L33), and generic/custom `Shape` implementations), and the full spatial cell map (`cells` and `cellMap` with `clippedShape` entries).
  - Restores the decoded index in `fresh` state so iterators and spatial queries work immediately without calling `Build()`.
- **Shape Serialization & Fixes**:
  - Added `Encode`/`Decode` support for [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/point_vector.go#L49-L97), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/lax_polyline.go#L56-L105), [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/lax_polygon.go#L229-L337) (also fixed [`LaxPolygon.ChainPosition`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/lax_polygon.go#L209-L226)), and [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/lax_loop.go#L86-L140) (also fixed [`LaxLoop.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/lax_loop.go#L73-L79)).
  - Fixed [`Polyline.Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/polyline.go#L373-L377) to pass `*decoder` by pointer so decode errors propagate properly.
  - Added strict bounds and structural validation across decoders to return errors instead of panicking on truncated, corrupted, or oversized inputs.
  - Updated incremental update handling and [`EdgeIterator`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/shapeutil_edge_iterator.go#L54-L64) to use `nextID` so non-contiguous shape IDs after `Remove` are preserved.
- **Tests**:
  - Added round-trip, non-contiguous shape ID, query/iterator verification, and malformed/corrupted input tests in [shapeindex_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xnvkbkmh/s2/shapeindex_test.go#L575-L1143).
